europa.x: Jovian ocean moon transformed into a nascent sun-warmed biosphere in 2010: Odyssey Two ("All these worlds are yours except Europa. Attempt no landing there.").
Landing site of the privately funded Europa One expedition investigating hydrothermal vents and bioluminescent aquatic life beneath the cracked ice of Conamara Chaos.
Smooth ice-covered Jovian moon containing twice the liquid water of all Earth’s oceans combined beneath a 15–25 km ice shell, target of Europa Clipper.

eps-ind-ab.x: Spectacular directly imaged cold Jovian world revealed by JWST MIRI coronagraphy at 10.65 and 15.5 microns.
Cold super-Jupiter directly imaged by JWST MIRI at 12 light-years, the coldest and oldest exoplanet ever imaged around a Sun-like star.
